name: codex-plugin-to-claude
description: Open-source Codex Skill and Plugin for bounded Claude Code review of high-risk development work.

interface.shortDescription: Claude Code review for high-risk Codex work
interface.longDescription: A free open-source Codex Skill and Plugin for dual-model development. OpenAI Codex remains the primary AI coding agent while Claude Code independently reviews a bounded sanitized brief. Explicit requests run directly; high-risk work asks for approval first. Reviews return PASS, FAIL, or ASK and never grant Claude repository tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-plugin-to-claude to cross-review this important change.
Ask Claude to challenge this diagnosis before I implement it.
Have Claude review this tested fix for material risks.
